title: UK Faces 'Weeks of Uncertainty' as Starmer Leadership Crisis Deepens After Streeting Resignation
detail: Bloomberg published a major feature-length analysis on 15 May 2026 titled 'How Keir Starmer's Leadership Fell into Crisis and Plunged Britain into Chaos', tracing the cascading sequence of events from the 7 May local election results through Wes Streeting's resignation. International media described a United Kingdom in political limbo, with multiple outlets noting the country faced 'weeks of uncertainty' over its Prime Minister's future. The formal Labour leadership challenge mechanism — requiring nominations from one-fifth of Labour MPs (81 members) — had not yet been triggered, but political analysts expected it to be activated within weeks. Starmer's team attempted to manage the crisis by promising a 'reset' of the government's communications strategy and renewed focus on economic delivery, but these overtures were met with scepticism by Labour MPs who questioned whether Starmer could still win a general election.
